title: RunOfShowItem
description: One item of a wedding's run of show (issue #45): what happens when on the day, who owns it, and — for a vendor's item — when that vendor must arrive. Stored under groupedKey(wedding_id, item_id) and read one wedding at a time.

item_id.description: Identity within the owning tenant's partition, from the injected id generator.

tenant_id.description: The owning tenant. Compared to the context's tenant only; never selects the partition.

starts_at.description: Local date and time it starts (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM, like the wedding's events).

ends_at.description: Local date and time it ends, when it has an end (not before it starts).

owner.description: Who owns it: the planner, the couple, or one of the wedding's vendors (owner_vendor_id).

owner_vendor_id.description: The vendor (of the same wedding) who owns it, when owner is vendor.

vendor_call_time.description: When the owning vendor must arrive, for a vendor's item (local date and time).

event_id.description: The wedding event (issue #29) it belongs to, when it belongs to one.

notes.description: The planner's notes (the couple does not see them).

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC creation time, from the injected clock.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC time of the last change, when changed.
